title: 31.8%: Tencent's new AI just sped up its own servers
description:
On August 28 Tencent released and open-sourced Hy4 preview: 770 billion total parameters, 49 billion active per token, a context window over a million tokens, and API pricing at $0.834 per million input tokens.

The headline is the model. The interesting part is one paragraph further down its own announcement.

Hy4 preview analysed the bottlenecks in its own inference system and ran multiple rounds of optimisation on things like operator fusion and communication between chips. End-to-end throughput rose 31.8% against the baseline, with consistent gains across context lengths and concurrency levels. Tencent describes the wider process as an early-stage recursive self-improvement loop: the model proposed approaches, ran experiments, and fed the results back into the next round.

Source: Tencent's own release note, August 28, 2026.

The open question nobody has answered: if each model tunes the stack the next one trains on, where does that loop stop?
